title: Basie's royalties and Eddie Durham's payout
summary: Basie gets royalties every year while Eddie Durham told Smith he got a one-time payment.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: I wonder if anybody does get royalties for "One O'Clock Jump."
Yeah, Basie gets plenty of royalties. He gets royalties every year.
Last time, Eddie Durham told me that he went down there and the record company gave him... Of course, it's so old, and he got $16,000/$68,000(?). Walked out. That's why I'm going back to New York.
It really hurts to hear that.
